stories.title: Bejlek Shocks World No. 1 Sabalenka in Cincinnati Round of 16

x_posts.label: Post 1-1
x_posts.text: Down 5-1 in the first-set tiebreak vs. the world No. 1 — and Sara Bejlek just kept going. She beat Sabalenka 7-6, 6-4 in Cincinnati. Four double faults. 50% first serves. Sabalenka had nothing. #Tennis #Cincinnati #WTA #Bejlek

x_posts.label: Post 1-2
x_posts.text: Sabalenka: No. 1 in the world. 0 aces. 4 double faults. 50% first serve. Beaten by No. 35 Sara Bejlek 7-6, 6-4. Cincinnati just served up the upset of the summer. #Tennis #Cincinnati #Sabalenka #WTA

stories.title: Paul Stuns Zverev, Four Americans Reach Cincinnati QFs

x_posts.label: Post 2-1
x_posts.text: Tommy Paul saved a match point, then beat top seed Zverev 4-6, 7-6, 6-4. Also today: Tiafoe, Fritz, and Nakashima all won. FOUR Americans in the Cincinnati ATP quarterfinals. When was the last time that happened? #Tennis #Cincinnati #ATP #USAtennis

x_posts.label: Post 2-2
x_posts.text: Both No. 1 ATP seeds — Zverev AND Auger-Aliassime — are out of Cincinnati. Paul beat Zverev. Tiafoe beat FAA. The draw is wide open. And four Americans are in the quarterfinals. #Tennis #Cincinnati #ATP #TommyPaul

stories.title: Who Is Sara Bejlek? Cincinnati's Biggest Surprise

x_posts.label: Post 5
x_posts.text: Sara Bejlek is 20 years old, ranked No. 35, and she was 0-3 vs. top-10 opponents before today. She just beat the world No. 1. Now she faces Madison Keys in the Cincinnati quarterfinals. Get used to that name. #Tennis #Bejlek #Cincinnati #WTA
